title: Document Record
description: A document in the repository. Merges the two originals - mdm.documents and the per-entry shape from documents.schema.json - into one record. title -> label, description -> summary, the kebab id -> slug, doc_type -> category.kind, topics -> category.domain, authors/mentions/citations -> relations, path/file_type/size_bytes/checksum -> attachments, date_added -> created_at. embedding and embedding_model are deliberately absent: they bloat every record and are invalidated wholesale on a model change, so they belong in a sidecar keyed by (record_id, model, version).

publisher.description: Issuing body as plain text. When the publisher exists as an organization record, add a relations entry with rel='publisher' as well - the string stays for display and for sources you never model.

publication_date.description: Publisher's original publication date. YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM / YYYY when that is all that is known - which is why this is not format: date.

abstract.description: Longer than `summary`, which stays short enough for search snippets.

citation.description: Formatted citation string for reuse in other documents.
